messages:
devon: FYI support ticket #12345 — customer reports a sudden burst of 401s and a billing spike after we rolled cross-SDK clients yesterday.

maya: omg, do we know which SDK/version?

devon: python-client 0.8.3 -> 0.9.0 and ts-client 0.6.0 -> 0.6.1. Regen happened from openapi-generator 6.1.0 -> 6.2.0 via regen-bot.

liam: can you paste a failing request/log? short one is fine.

devon: here's sanitized curl from the customer showing the header set:

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -H "x-api-key: sk-customer-abc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer tok-xyz" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

devon: billing shows requests were attributed to api key rather than bearer token; customer used token auth in SDK but regen added x-api-key header when config.apiKey was present.

rachel: that's bad — header priority in our billing router picks x-api-key first. I thought we normalized headers.

liam: I can reproduce locally. running python example toggling client config:

```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(token='tok-xyz')
# old client: no x-api-key
# new client (post-regen) sets client.api_key if env var present
print(c._session.headers)
```

liam: regen-bot's patch introduced `apiKey` model property in securitySchemes and generator mapped it to a header for both languages.

maya: can we bisect to the generator change? regen-bot logs show it used template v6.2.0.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolled client packages to npm/pypi: python 0.9.0, ts 0.6.1 at 2026-02-08T23:40Z

devon: immediate mitigation: publish hotfix to remove x-api-key emission when token is set, and rollback npm/pypi tags. Also we'll credit the affected account.

rachel: open PR to add explicit test in regen CI: verify no `x-api-key` header emitted when token auth configured. Also add changelog check in auto-regen workflow (regen-bot must create changelog entry or fail).

liam: bisect plan: reproduce with openapi-generator 6.1.0 (works) vs 6.2.0 (breaks) and locate template change. I've started bisect on my laptop.

maya: notify support and ops. @support-bot can you add incident label and track credits? Customer is on enterprise.

support-bot: Incident created INC-2026-78, assigned to @devon. Credit flow initiated.

devon: timeline: hotfix + rollback in next 2h, full patch in CI + changelog guard by EOD. I'll dump a postmortem stub into /postmortems/ after action items.

rachel: thanks. once hotfix is out let's run canary against a few top customers.

liam: note for release: also check TS client header serialization — there was a lowercasing change that may have influenced acceptance in some proxies.

devon: good point. test matrix: python/ts/go, token-only, apikey-only, both present.

maya: any objections to adding a test harness that simulates our billing router to catch attribution regressions?

rachel: yes please. add integration test in dedicated regen-ci that posts to a fake billing-router and asserts billing key used.

devon: ok I'm on it. will update thread with PR links.

rachel: :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: note: rolling back package versions will trigger client consumers to pin older versions; we should communicate in #clients-release.

devon: drafting a support message for the customer now.
